text: Soleo is a swimming-pool brand of R.P. Industries, S.A., a pool maker founded in 1994 with its head office in the Sobreposta industrial park, Braga.
short: Soleo is the pool brand of R.P. Industries, S.A. (Braga).

source.name: Empresas de Piscinas SOLEO | RP Industries Piscinas
source.quote: é com a gama SOLEO que a RP INDUSTRIES usufrui de um protagonismo singular no mercado global de empresas de piscinas
source.note: The site's certificate chain is incomplete (the server doesn't send the Let's Encrypt intermediate), so scripts fail TLS verification; the page was read with verification off on 2026-09-28. The same page says 'Criada em 1994' and gives the head office as Parque Industrial de Sobreposta, Braga; its privacy text names R.P. Industries, S.A.
